verses.original: הֲלֹֽא־ חָכְמָ֥ה תִקְרָ֑א וּ֝תְבוּנָ֗ה תִּתֵּ֥ן קוֹלָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: hă·lō- ḥāḵ·māh ṯiq·rā ū·ṯə·ḇū·nāh tit·tên qō·w·lāh
verses.literal: Does not wisdom call out and understanding raise her voice
verses.literalPt: Não clama, porventura, a Sabedoria, e não eleva o Entendimento a sua voz?

verses.original: בְּרֹאשׁ־ מְרוֹמִ֥ים עֲלֵי־ דָ֑רֶךְ בֵּ֖ית נְתִיב֣וֹת נִצָּֽבָה׃
verses.transliteration: bə·rōš- mə·rō·w·mîm ‘ă·lê- ḏā·reḵ bêṯ nə·ṯî·ḇō·wṯ niṣ·ṣā·ḇāh
verses.literal: On the heights . . . overlooking the road at the crossroads . . . she takes her stand
verses.literalPt: No cume das alturas, junto ao caminho, nas encruzilhadas, ela se coloca;

verses.original: לְיַד־ שְׁעָרִ֥ים לְפִי־ קָ֑רֶת מְב֖וֹא פְתָחִ֣ים תָּרֹֽנָּה׃
verses.transliteration: lə·yaḏ- šə·‘ā·rîm lə·p̄î- qā·reṯ mə·ḇō·w p̄ə·ṯā·ḥîm tā·rōn·nāh
verses.literal: Beside the gates to the city at the entrances . . . she cries out
verses.literalPt: junto às portas, à entrada da cidade, à entrada das portas ela grita:

verses.original: אֲלֵיכֶ֣ם אִישִׁ֣ים אֶקְרָ֑א וְ֝קוֹלִ֗י אֶל־ בְּנֵ֥י אָדָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·lê·ḵem ’î·šîm ’eq·rā wə·qō·w·lî ’el- bə·nê ’ā·ḏām
verses.literal: To you O men I call out and my cry is to the sons of men
verses.literalPt: A vós, ó homens, clamo. E a minha voz dirige-se aos filhos dos homens.

verses.original: הָבִ֣ינוּ פְתָאיִ֣ם עָרְמָ֑ה וּ֝כְסִילִ֗ים הָבִ֥ינוּ לֵֽב׃
verses.transliteration: hā·ḇî·nū p̄ə·ṯā·yim ‘ā·rə·māh ū·ḵə·sî·lîm hā·ḇî·nū lêḇ
verses.literal: O simple ones learn to be shrewd O fools gain understanding . . .
verses.literalPt: Entendei, ó estúpidos, a prudência; entendei, ó loucos, a sabedoria.

verses.original: שִׁ֭מְעוּ כִּֽי־ נְגִידִ֣ים אֲדַבֵּ֑ר וּמִפְתַּ֥ח שְׂ֝פָתַ֗י מֵישָׁרִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: Šim·ʿû kî- nə·ḡî·ḏîm ’ă·ḏab·bêr ū·mip̄·taḥ śə·p̲ā·t̲ai mê·šā·rîm
verses.literal: Listen for I speak of noble things and the opening of my lips will reveal right
verses.literalPt: Ouvi, pois falarei coisas excelentes; e proferirão os meus lábios coisas retas.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ אֱ֭מֶת יֶהְגֶּ֣ה חִכִּ֑י וְתוֹעֲבַ֖ת שְׂפָתַ֣י רֶֽשַׁע׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ’ĕ·meṯ yeh·geh ḥik·kî wə·ṯō·w·‘ă·ḇaṯ śə·p̄ā·ṯay re·ša‘
verses.literal: For my mouth will speak the truth and wickedness is detestable to my lips
verses.literalPt: A minha boca pronunciará a verdade, e os meus lábios abominam a perversidade.

verses.original: בְּצֶ֥דֶק כָּל־ אִמְרֵי־ פִ֑י אֵ֥ין בָּ֝הֶ֗ם נִפְתָּ֥ל וְעִקֵּֽשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: bə·ṣe·ḏeq kāl- ’im·rê- p̄î ’ên bā·hem nip̄·tāl wə·‘iq·qêš
verses.literal: All the words of my mouth are righteous none are crooked or perverse
verses.literalPt: Justas são todas as palavras da minha boca; nelas, não há coisa torta ou perversa.

verses.original: כֻּלָּ֣ם נְ֭כֹחִים לַמֵּבִ֑ין וִֽ֝ישָׁרִ֗ים לְמֹ֣צְאֵי דָֽעַת׃
verses.transliteration: kul·lām nə·ḵō·ḥîm lam·mê·ḇîn wî·šā·rîm lə·mō·ṣə·’ê ḏā·‘aṯ
verses.literal: They are all plain to the discerning and upright to those who find knowledge
verses.literalPt: Todas elas são claras para os que entendem e retas para os que acham o conhecimento.

verses.original: קְחֽוּ־ מוּסָרִ֥י וְאַל־ כָּ֑סֶף וְ֝דַ֗עַת מֵחָר֥וּץ נִבְחָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: qə·ḥū- mū·sā·rî wə·’al- kā·sep̄ wə·ḏa·‘aṯ mê·ḥā·rūṣ niḇ·ḥār
verses.literal: Receive my instruction instead of silver and knowledge rather than pure gold
verses.literalPt: Recebei a minha instrução e não a prata; e o conhecimento, antes do que o ouro escolhido.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ טוֹבָ֣ה חָ֭כְמָה מִפְּנִינִ֑ים וְכָל־ חֲ֝פָצִ֗ים לֹ֣א יִֽשְׁווּ־ בָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ṭō·w·ḇāh ḥāḵ·māh mip·pə·nî·nîm wə·ḵāl ḥă·p̄ā·ṣîm lō yiš·wū- ḇāh
verses.literal: For wisdom is more precious than rubies and nothing . . . you desire compares with her
verses.literalPt: Pois a sabedoria é melhor do que os corais; e tudo o que se pode desejar não é para ser comparado com ela.

verses.original: אֲ‍ֽנִי־ חָ֭כְמָה שָׁכַ֣נְתִּי עָרְמָ֑ה וְדַ֖עַת מְזִמּ֣וֹת אֶמְצָֽא׃
verses.transliteration: ’ănî- ḥāḵ·māh šā·ḵan·tî ‘ā·rə·māh wə·ḏa·‘aṯ mə·zim·mō·wṯ ’em·ṣā
verses.literal: I wisdom dwell together with prudence and I find knowledge and discretion
verses.literalPt: Eu, a Sabedoria, tenho a prudência por morada e possuo o conhecimento e a discrição.

verses.original: יִֽרְאַ֣ת יְהוָה֮ שְֽׂנֹ֫את רָ֥ע גֵּ֘אָ֤ה וְגָא֨וֹן׀ וְדֶ֣רֶךְ רָ֭ע וּפִ֨י תַהְפֻּכ֬וֹת שָׂנֵֽאתִי׃
verses.transliteration: yir·’aṯ Yah·weh śə·nōṯ rā‘ gê·’āh wə·ḡā·’ō·wn wə·ḏe·reḵ rā‘ ū·p̄î ṯah·pu·ḵō·wṯ śā·nê·ṯî
verses.literal: To fear the LORD is to hate evil I hate arrogant pride evil conduct and perverse speech
verses.literalPt: O temor de Jeová é odiar o mal. A soberba, e a arrogância, e o mau caminho, e a boca perversa, eu os odeio.

verses.original: לִֽי־ עֵ֭צָה וְתוּשִׁיָּ֑ה אֲנִ֥י בִ֝ינָ֗ה לִ֣י גְבוּרָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: lî- ‘ê·ṣāh wə·ṯū·šî·yāh ’ă·nî ḇî·nāh lî ḡə·ḇū·rāh
verses.literal: Counsel and sound judgment are mine I have insight and strength
verses.literalPt: Meu é o conselho e a verdadeira sabedoria; eu sou o Entendimento, minha é a fortaleza.

verses.original: בִּ֭י מְלָכִ֣ים יִמְלֹ֑כוּ וְ֝רוֹזְנִ֗ים יְחֹ֣קְקוּ צֶֽדֶק׃
verses.transliteration: bî mə·lā·ḵîm yim·lō·ḵū wə·rō·wz·nîm yə·ḥō·qə·qū ṣe·ḏeq
verses.literal: By me kings reign and rulers enact just laws
verses.literalPt: Por meio de mim, reinam os reis, e os governadores decretam o que é justo.

verses.original: בִּ֭י שָׂרִ֣ים יָשֹׂ֑רוּ וּ֝נְדִיבִ֗ים כָּל־ שֹׁ֥פְטֵי צֶֽדֶק׃
verses.transliteration: bî śā·rîm yā·śō·rū ū·nə·ḏî·ḇîm kāl- šō·p̄ə·ṭê ṣe·ḏeq
verses.literal: By me princes rule and all nobles who govern justly
verses.literalPt: Por meio de mim, governam os príncipes, e os nobres, todos os juízes da terra.

verses.original: אֲ֭נִי אֹהֲבֶיהָ אֵהָ֑ב וּ֝מְשַׁחֲרַ֗י יִמְצָאֻֽנְנִי׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·nî ʾō·hă·ḇɛ·hå̄ ’ê·hāḇ ū·mə·ša·ḥă·ray yim·ṣā·’un·nî
verses.literal: I love those who love me and those who seek me early shall find me
verses.literalPt: Eu amo os que me amam; e os que me procuram diligentemente me acharão.

verses.original: עֹֽשֶׁר־ וְכָב֥וֹד אִתִּ֑י ה֥וֹן עָ֝תֵ֗ק וּצְדָקָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ō·šer- wə·ḵā·ḇō·wḏ ’it·tî hō·wn ‘ā·ṯêq ū·ṣə·ḏā·qāh
verses.literal: With me are riches and honor enduring wealth and righteousness
verses.literalPt: Riquezas e honra estão comigo, bens duráveis e justiça.

verses.original: ט֣וֹב פִּ֭רְיִי מֵחָר֣וּץ וּמִפָּ֑ז וּ֝תְבוּאָתִ֗י מִכֶּ֥סֶף נִבְחָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: ṭō·wḇ pir·yî mê·ḥā·rūṣ ū·mip·pāz ū·ṯə·ḇū·’ā·ṯî mik·ke·sep̄ niḇ·ḥār
verses.literal: My fruit is better than gold pure gold and my harvest surpasses choice silver
verses.literalPt: Melhor é o meu fruto do que o ouro, do que o ouro fino; e a minha renda, do que a prata escolhida.

verses.original: בְּאֹֽרַח־ צְדָקָ֥ה אֲהַלֵּ֑ך בְּ֝ת֗וֹךְ נְתִיב֥וֹת מִשְׁפָּֽט׃
verses.transliteration: bə·’ō·raḥ- ṣə·ḏā·qāh ʾă·hal·lēḵ bə·ṯō·wḵ nə·ṯî·ḇō·wṯ miš·pāṭ
verses.literal: I walk in the way of righteousness along the paths of justice
verses.literalPt: Ando pelo caminho da justiça, no meio das veredas do juízo,

verses.original: לְהַנְחִ֖יל אֹהֲבַ֥י׀ יֵ֑שׁ וְאֹצְרֹ֖תֵיהֶ֣ם אֲמַלֵּֽא׃פ
verses.transliteration: lə·han·ḥîl ’ō·hă·ḇay yêš wə·’ō·ṣə·rō·ṯê·hem ’ă·mal·lê
verses.literal: bestowing wealth on those who love me and making their treasuries full
verses.literalPt: para dotar de bens os que me amam e encher os seus tesouros.

verses.original: יְֽהוָ֗ה קָ֭נָנִי רֵאשִׁ֣ית דַּרְכּ֑וֹ קֶ֖דֶם מִפְעָלָ֣יו מֵאָֽז׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh qā·nā·nî rê·šîṯ dar·kōw qe·ḏem mip̄·‘ā·lāw mê·’āz
verses.literal: The LORD created me as His first course before His works of old
verses.literalPt: Jeová me possuiu no princípio dos seus caminhos, antes das suas obras da antiguidade.

verses.original: מֵ֭עוֹלָם נִסַּ֥כְתִּי מֵרֹ֗אשׁ מִקַּדְמֵי־ אָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: mê·‘ō·w·lām nis·saḵ·tî mê·rōš miq·qaḏ·mê- ’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: From everlasting I was established from the beginning before the earth began
verses.literalPt: Desde a antiguidade, fui constituída, desde o princípio, antes de existir a terra.

verses.original: בְּאֵין־ תְּהֹמ֥וֹת חוֹלָ֑לְתִּי בְּאֵ֥ין מַ֝עְיָנ֗וֹת נִכְבַּדֵּי־ מָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: bə·’ên- tə·hō·mō·wṯ ḥō·w·lā·lə·tî bə·’ên ma‘·yā·nō·wṯ niḵ·bad·dê- mā·yim
verses.literal: When there were no watery depths I was brought forth when no springs were overflowing with water
verses.literalPt: Quando ainda não havia abismos, fui dada à luz; quando ainda não havia fontes cheias de água.

verses.original: בְּטֶ֣רֶם הָרִ֣ים הָטְבָּ֑עוּ לִפְנֵ֖י גְבָע֣וֹת חוֹלָֽלְתִּי׃
verses.transliteration: bə·ṭe·rem hā·rîm hā·ṭə·bā·‘ū lip̄·nê ḡə·ḇā·‘ō·wṯ ḥō·w·lā·lə·tî
verses.literal: Before the mountains were settled before the hills I was brought forth
verses.literalPt: Antes de serem firmados os montes, antes de haver outeiros, fui dada à luz.

verses.original: עַד־ לֹ֣א עָ֭שָׂה אֶ֣רֶץ וְחוּצ֑וֹת וְ֝רֹ֗אשׁ עָפְר֥וֹת תֵּבֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: ‘aḏ- lō ‘ā·śāh ’e·reṣ wə·ḥū·ṣō·wṯ wə·rōš ʿå̄·p̄ə·rōṯ tê·ḇêl
verses.literal: before . . . He made the land or fields or any of the dust of the earth
verses.literalPt: Quando ele ainda não tinha feito a terra, nem os campos, nem o princípio do pó do mundo.

verses.original: בַּהֲכִינ֣וֹ שָׁ֭מַיִם שָׁ֣ם אָ֑נִי בְּח֥וּקוֹ ח֝֗וּג עַל־ פְּנֵ֥י תְהֽוֹם׃
verses.transliteration: ba·hă·ḵî·nōw šā·ma·yim šām ’ā·nî bə·ḥū·qōw ḥūḡ ‘al- pə·nê ṯə·hō·wm
verses.literal: I was there when He established the heavens when He inscribed a circle on the face of the deep
verses.literalPt: Quando ele preparava os céus, lá estava eu; quando traçava um círculo sobre a face do abismo,

verses.original: בְּאַמְּצ֣וֹ שְׁחָקִ֣ים מִמָּ֑עַל בַּ֝עֲז֗וֹז עִינ֥וֹת תְּהוֹם׃
verses.transliteration: bə·’am·mə·ṣōw šə·ḥā·qîm mim·mā·‘al ba·‘ă·zō·wz ‘î·nō·wṯ tə·hōm
verses.literal: when He established the clouds above when the fountains of the deep gushed forth
verses.literalPt: quando estabelecia o firmamento lá em cima, quando as fontes do abismo eram firmadas.

verses.original: בְּשׂ֘וּמ֤וֹ לַיָּ֨ם׀ חֻקּ֗וֹ וּ֭מַיִם לֹ֣א יַֽעַבְרוּ־ פִ֑יו בְּ֝חוּק֗וֹ מ֣וֹסְדֵי אָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: bə·śū·mōw lay·yām ḥuq·qōw ū·ma·yim lō ya·‘aḇ·rū- p̄îw bə·ḥū·qōw mō·ws·ḏê ’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: when He set a boundary for the sea so that the waters would not surpass His command when He marked out the foundations of the earth
verses.literalPt: quando fixava ao mar o seu termo, para que as águas não transgredissem o seu mando. Quando lançava os alicerces da terra,

verses.original: וָֽאֶהְיֶ֥ה אֶצְל֗וֹ אָ֫מ֥וֹן וָֽאֶהְיֶ֣ה שַׁ֭עֲשֻׁעִים י֤וֹם׀ י֑וֹם מְשַׂחֶ֖קֶת לְפָנָ֣יו בְּכָל־ עֵֽת׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’eh·yeh ’eṣ·lōw ’ā·mō·wn wā·’eh·yeh ‘ă·šu·‘îm yō·wm yō·wm mə·śa·ḥe·qeṯ lə·p̄ā·nāw bə·ḵāl ‘êṯ
verses.literal: Then I was a skilled craftsman at His side and His delight day by day rejoicing always . . . in His presence
verses.literalPt: então, estava eu ao seu lado como arquiteto e enchia-me de gozo dia após dia, regozijando-me sempre diante dele;

verses.original: מְ֭שַׂחֶקֶת בְּתֵבֵ֣ל אַרְצ֑וֹ וְ֝שַׁעֲשֻׁעַ֗י אֶת־ בְּנֵ֥י אָדָֽם׃פ
verses.transliteration: mə·śa·ḥe·qeṯ bə·ṯê·ḇêl ’ar·ṣōw wə·ša·‘ă·šu·‘ay ’eṯ- bə·nê ’ā·ḏām
verses.literal: I was rejoicing in His whole world . . . delighting together in the sons of men
verses.literalPt: regozijando-me na sua terra habitável e achando as minhas delícias com os filhos dos homens.

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֣ה בָ֭נִים שִׁמְעוּ־ לִ֑י וְ֝אַשְׁרֵ֗י דְּרָכַ֥י יִשְׁמֹֽרוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh ḇā·nîm šim·‘ū- lî wə·’aš·rê də·rā·ḵay yiš·mō·rū
verses.literal: Now therefore my sons listen to me for blessed are those who keep my ways
verses.literalPt: Agora, pois, filhos, ouvi-me; pois felizes são os que observam os meus caminhos.

verses.original: שִׁמְע֖וּ מוּסָ֥ר וַחֲכָ֗מוּ וְאַל־ תִּפְרָֽעוּ׃
verses.transliteration: šim·‘ū mū·sār wa·ḥă·ḵā·mū wə·’al- tip̄·rā·‘ū
verses.literal: Listen to instruction and be wise do not ignore it
verses.literalPt: Ouvi a instrução, e sede sábios, e não a rejeiteis.

verses.original: אַ֥שְֽׁרֵי אָדָם֮ שֹׁמֵ֪עַֽ֫ לִ֥י לִשְׁקֹ֣ד עַל־ דַּ֭לְתֹתַי י֤וֹם׀ י֑וֹם לִ֝שְׁמֹ֗ר מְזוּזֹ֥ת פְּתָחָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ’aš·rê ’ā·ḏām šō·mê·a‘ lî liš·qōḏ ‘al- dal·ṯō·ṯay yō·wm yō·wm liš·mōr mə·zū·zōṯ pə·ṯā·ḥāy
verses.literal: Blessed is the man who listens to me watching daily . . . at my doors waiting at the posts of my doorway
verses.literalPt: Feliz é o homem que me ouve, velando todos os dias às minhas entradas, esperando junto às ombreiras das minhas portas;

verses.original: כִּ֣י מֹ֭צְאִי מֹצְאֵי חַיִּ֑ים וַיָּ֥פֶק רָ֝צ֗וֹן מֵיְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kî mō·ṣə·’î mō·ṣə·ʾē ḥay·yîm way·yā·p̄eq rā·ṣō·wn Yah·weh
verses.literal: For whoever finds me finds life and obtains the favor of the LORD
verses.literalPt: pois quem me achar achará a vida e alcançará o favor de Jeová.

verses.original: וְֽ֭חֹטְאִי חֹמֵ֣ס נַפְשׁ֑וֹ כָּל־ מְ֝שַׂנְאַ֗י אָ֣הֲבוּ מָֽוֶת׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·ḥō·ṭə·’î ḥō·mês nap̄·šōw kāl- mə·śan·’ay ’ā·hă·ḇū mā·weṯ
verses.literal: But he who fails to find me harms himself all who hate me love death
verses.literalPt: Aquele, porém, que pecar contra mim faz o mal à sua própria alma. Todos os que me odeiam amam a morte.
